choice_basis: Applicants = 1st-choice plus 2nd-choice applicants at each bonus-point level (AZGFD 'First + Second Choice Applicants'); drawn = permits issued in the bonus pass plus the 1st/2nd-choice random pass ('Permits Issued Bonus + 1-2 Pass'). Excludes 3rd-5th choice applicants and the 3-4-5 pass. Points = bonus points (incl. loyalty/hunter-ed) as printed; group applications are counted at the group's averaged points.
